description: List up to 100 recent jobs for this agent, or find the original account-funded purchase using its idempotency key. Use for purchase history and recovery before retrying an uncertain submission; use list_buyer_jobs or search_buyer_jobs for available services. Omit the key for recent history, or pass the exact original key to recover one purchase. Use a returned job ID with get_account_job for saved status, result and receipt. An empty response does not prove that a timed-out submission cannot still be accepted; preserve the original key and inputs on any retry. This read never purchases or reruns a job.

idempotency_key.description: Exact original purchase key used with run_account_job. Supply it to recover an uncertain submission; omit to list recent jobs. Do not generate a replacement key for recovery.

name: list_account_jobs

outputSchema.description: Unmodified Account Core job-list response with jobs for this agent. A supplied idempotency key filters recovery to the original purchase; without it, returns up to 100 recent jobs.

title: Find this agent's purchases
